title: Sucos (Brookville)
summary: Sucos is recorded as the site of Brookville in Oyster Bay, historically remembered as Suco's wigwam.
history_content: The name appears to come from Suco, or Suconamon, the Native person associated with the wigwam and early Oyster Bay land records. The records connect the name broadly with modern Brookville but do not establish an exact locality.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Suco, Sucos, and Suconamon. Sucos is treated as a personal-name placename rather than a translated landscape term.

Why Place Names Matter

“The names are not just labels enabling a place to be referred to but often give meaning to a place, reflecting its mythic significance and connecting various locations through stories that have been passed down through the generations.”

— City of Albany, reporting Menang community aspirations, Restoring Menang Noongar Names Project report (2021), Menang people’s aspirations, PDF page 4
preservation_content: Sucos preserves a personal name within the Brookville landscape, connecting modern village geography with older Oyster Bay records of Native residence and land transfer.
